attackers_goals: An attacker may add additional roles or permissions to an attacker controlled cloud account to maintain persistent access to a tenant.
description: An Azure application was observed assigning an Azure administrator role to a user. This might indicate a privilege escalation attempt.
investigative_actions: Check if the affected account is new to the organization. Check whether the application that added the account to the role is permitted to perform such actions. Check what can be affected by the assigned role* Follow further actions done by the account that was added to the role.
name: Azure Privilege Escalation Using an Application
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
